senses.gloss: to make one’s self lord; (homilet.; cmp. שִׁרְבֵּב) to stretch one’s self.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 9b:4">Yoma 9ᵇ</cite> (play on <he>מהשֹתֹרֹעֹ</he>, <cite ref="Isaiah 28:20">Is. XXVIII, 20</cite>) <he>קצר מצע זה מֵהִשְׂ֗תָּ֗רֵר עליו שני ר̇ע̇ים כאחד</he> this couch is too narrow for two lovers to stretch themselves on it (Ms. O. a.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 302">Yalk. Is. 302</cite> <he>מהשתרע</he>, v. <cite ref="U01998"><he>שָׂרַע</he></cite>); <cite ref="Sanhedrin 103b:9">Snh. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>מִלְּהִשְׂתָּרֵר</he>.
